name: 3D Tapered Branch Tubes + Instanced Foliage
purpose: Materialize real 3D tapered branch geometry and replaceable instanced foliage strictly downstream of accepted PlantRenderDescription.
pipeline: accepted GrowthGraph -> accepted PlantRenderDescription -> RendererProfile -> Plant3DMaterializer -> ArrayMesh branches + MultiMesh foliage

implementation.branch_geometry: SurfaceTool triangle tubes with per-segment start/end radii and profile-controlled radial sides
implementation.foliage: MultiMesh using replaceable QuadMesh leaf asset and deterministic anchor transforms

truth_invariants: Plant3DMaterializer consumes PlantRenderDescription and never writes GrowthGraph
mesh vertex count, radial sides, foliage asset and foliage instance count are presentation only
geometry hash is derived from source GrowthGraph hash + render description + renderer profile + active primitives
same accepted description/profile rebuilds the same geometry hash in a fresh process
TREE/BUSH/GRASS remain non-canonical observations, not renderer identities

windows_gate.focused: build all three 3D profiles across all seven accepted PH2 phenotypes; verify mesh counts/AABB/MultiMesh counts and source graph immutability
windows_gate.visual_smoke: instantiate the real Node3D lab and switch branch-only/full procedural modes
windows_gate.restart: focused and fresh-process REFERENCE BRANCH_LEAF_INSTANCED/FULL_PROCEDURAL geometry hashes must match
windows_gate.graphical: inspect contrasting environments and confirm visible tapered 3D branches and foliage while GrowthGraph hash remains unchanged

scope_boundary: S2 proves actual 3D branch and foliage materialization, not final botanical assets, wind, bark/leaf shaders, production GPU batching, canopy clustering or impostor baking.
